reviews.text: This specific GoodVets always does a phenomenal job with my pup. The care team is always attentive and really explain every detail and educate you. Thank you to all the staff that help me and my dog ease our anxieties when it comes to the vet. I’ve have yet to have a bad experience here.

I take my family's cats and dog there. The staff is very kind and professional.

The prices are fair and clear. They don't add things on or have you return to address issues that could have been handled initially. Also, the communication is clear and the veterinarians take the time to speak with you directly without rushing.
The entire staff is patient & helpful.  They advise not only on pets' health but on services that may or may not be necessary.  The parking lot is a big help!
The staff took very good care of our cat and the appointments were very quick and inexpensive! Highly recommend and will be back with our kitten! We have found our new family vet!

I brought my cat in during an emergency and the woman at the front desk was extremely rude, insensitive and refused to even ask if one of the doctors if they would look at my cat to ensure she was stable enough to make it to an emergency vet. If your pet’s life counts on it do not go to this place. They don’t hire people who care.
Great service and awesome staff
Hi, Daniel. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
I’ve

Hi, Jonathan. We are sorry to hear that we didn’t meet your expectation. We have very high expectations at GoodVets Andersonville and would love the opportunity to improve. Please get in touch with us at (312) 680-9064!

AVOID THIS PLACE. basically the vet version of a magazine subscription you can never cancel. i've called this place numerous times to tell them to stop scheduling random appointments without my knowledge or consent. they continue to do so, then blast me with emails and texts about these ghost appointments. this on top of how expensive everything is... avoid them like the plague. the absolute definition of trying to make vet services into a profit based industry. i'm done calling them to cancel appointments i've never set. most annoying business i've ever had the displeasure of interacting with.
Dr. Blanchard and vet tech, Jess were so sweet to me and my dog, Nova. We had an establishment/wellness visit and were in and out. 10/10, would recommend!

First time having to take my cat to the vet for any kind of emergency. The girls who checked my cat were very polite and answered all of my questions which i appreciate. The front desk though, spoke very sarcastic like, and seemed very annoyed by me asking any type of question. Maybe they were having a rough day? I dont know but im also not sure if I'll be returning to that location.
Hi, Cory. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!

I really wish I could give this place negative stars. Worst vet in Chicago for sure, probably the worst vet in the United States. Every time I go in they have a new vet, I’ve literally never got the same vet twice here. You absolutely will not get a regular vet that knows your animals. Also they are all horrible vets. Almost every time I go in I’m told since my dog is big he will need sedatives to be seen, but they will conveniently sell you overpriced sedatives at triple the cost and then charge you for a second visit since you have to come back once the animal is sedated. If you mention that they will say “well if you buy our overpriced discount membership for over $100 a month then the visit will be free” although they will charge you out the ass for everything else. Luckily I was able to get into Blum animal hospital the same day since my dog had a sprained ankle and needed to be checked to see how serious it was and see if X-rays/surgery was needed. Yet at Blum my dog didn’t need to be sedated, because their vets are competent unlike at GoodVets. Also god forbid you have an emergency I forgot my dogs meds and tried calling to tell them I was going to drive back up there and pick up the meds. I literally called 10 times. Got sent to voicemail four times, they answered and immediately hung up without saying anything once, and then got since to voicemail five more times in a row. When I pulled up to get my meds there were two girls sitting at the front chatting and literally filing their nails at the desk all while being to entitled to answer the god damm phone. If you love your pets or just don’t hate animals in general stay far far away from this place. It’s blatantly obvious that they only care about money and do not give a single shit about the health and wellbeing of your pets.
Hi, Cody.  Thank you so much for your kind review and trust with your furry family member. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!

I had the misfortune of bringing my foster cat to the goodvets of Andersonville. Out of my own pocket I spent over $1,500 to get tests, bloodwork, a spay etc. upon getting the cat adopted I found out that the tests they said they did didn’t happen to the tune of almost $500. When I called, texted and emailed I got stock answers or simply no answers at all. My interactions with the employees were positive, and it seemed like they cared, but to find out tests were not done (yet I was charged and never refunded when I called once I found out they were never done) is so disappointing. NEVER take your animals there.

They were quick and efficient while also being cost effective and friendly. The doctors did their best not to stress my animal out more than necessary. They provided me cost estimates and quotes for all my treatment plans.

the  vettech makayla was very kind and informative. Unfortunately, I took my dog here because he was having issues with his skin & diarrhea. I explained I was on a very strict budget as I am in school. The vet prescribe my animal medication that made his diarrhea worse, without pre-warning me. when I called about the medication, they told me I had to come in and Pay for another exam. I already paid for the exam when they prescribed the medication. They said the vet who saw my animal was an offsite Vet, so apparently that exam doesn’t count. They are overpriced and not worth the money. I couldn’t believe the vet prescribed my animal medication, knowing diarrhea was a symptom and did not pre-warned me. As for good Vet, only respond to my comment if you are intending on doing something to make this right. Just apologizing or saying that it was a misunderstanding, will not suffice. And please don’t say how you value feedback and want to improve. Do something actively to assist with my poor animals problem
AMAZING PLACE. Beautiful , warm, oomphy atmosphere. This will be my Kitties new Vet.
Wonderful experience! Love that you can text someone at the front desk!

We had to bring in our cat for an exam because the vet wouldn't refill his desmopressin prescription without going through the whole ($300+) set of senior tests we had done just under a year ago. I don't appreciate having his prescription held hostage like that, especially since we could have waited another month, switched to the plan that covers the senior panel, and saved considerably. If we continue with GoodVets (mainly because they're close), it won't be to go in for expensive tests twice in less than a year.
Hi, Travis. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!

I had an appointment for my dog to get a rabies and distemper vaccine on Saturday July 25, 2026.   I was called and told I needed to reschedule because it was a tech only and no vet available.  I agreed for Monday July 27, 2026.  When I arrived I was told I never confirmed the text they sent.  I reviewed my text and there was none.  I showed the receptionist my text messages chain from prior appointments but there was none from them for this one.  So they checked with the doctor and they agreed to get my dog in. This turned a quick visit into a 45 minute visit.  FYI if you have an appointment at good vets call ahead to reconfirm whether you receive a text or not.

Edit to Add: My cat has been on a new medication from his new vet for two weeks and his drooling has almost completely stopped and his pain has lessened so much so that he can eat and play and act like a cat again. He has even gained a little weight back. I am so happy I made the choice to go somewhere else, but it breaks my heart that GoodVets could have helped him and instead decided to take advantage of us financially. If he is doing this much better after two weeks, I can't wait to see how amazing he will be after the TWO MONTHS of antibiotics he has to be on thanks to the negligence of Goodvets just to get him to his dental appointment and after the dental he will finally be his old self. He literally would have died if Goodvets kept running test after test just to steal my money while making sure to not even investigate the obvious.  And I want to add that the last email I have from the manager says something about how she is glad to hear my cat is doing well, which was infuriating.  He isn't doing well. He is doing better. It is going to take months to undo the damage Goodvets caused.  Then she can passive aggressively speak to me about how glad she it. These people are not in the business of making your pets well. They simply want to make money, and frankly I don't think it matters to them what happens to your pet at all. Maybe the vets do still care somewhere deep inside. But they sold out and are making pets worse instead of better.
I hate that I have to give even one star. The vet is friendly,  maybe that's fine. The vet techs are rude and abrupt. And they almost killed my cat. I brought my cat in for a dental a year ago. He got 19 teeth out. When we went back for our recheck in May, I let them know my cat is in pain in his mouth and drooling constantly and has a hard time eating so he has been losing weight. They do not do exams in the treatment room, but told me his mouth looked great! They said it was likely a gi issue and who was i to argue. They did a blood panel and said it was fine, but that he might have cancer or a vitamin deficiency or tumors or pancreatitis....a whole slew of things. Panicked, I paid thousands of dollars for more tests and medicine and special food and yet everything came back fine and nothing helped. On every visit and every call, I kept asking if they were sure it wasn't his teeth. They kept saying his teeth were fine. A week after the last "fine", I took my cat for a second opinion.  He was getting worse and worse and losing more and more weight and the drooling was causing hot spots on his fur. He was clearly in so much pain. The new vet did the exam in the room and I was horrified at the lesions and swelling in his mouth.  As well as the fact that he currently only has four teeth left. So about 13 have just broken off or fallen out. The new vet stated he has a very clear cut case of stomatitis, but unfortunately now he is so infected they can't even do his dental until he undergoes two months of hard-core antibiotics to clear his infection.  I contacted the GoodVets before writing this review and asked for a refund of at least some of the thousands of dollars I spent on unnecessary tests and was told that this is "just how medicine goes " and they will not refund since diagnostics are hard. I have initiated a charge back with my bank and will be reporting to the IDPFR. Please, if you love your pets do not go here. They are more concerned with money and that leads them to negligence. I am so upset I believed them and due to their inability to provide care, my cat has been in pain for months. I am so thankful I followed my gut and got another opinion before they killed him.
Always treat me and my pets well whenever we come in. And our doctor is fantastic. Absolutely recommend.

Probably the most expensive animal vet in the neighborhood, I would stay away if you are looking for a decent price on anything, even a simple check and inspection costs 100 bucks, just to look at my cat, seriously? The most expensive vet service prices I have ever seen, Car dealership esque,  truly crazy.
Very professional, clean environment. Able to get an appointment easily. Staff connected well with our elderly (anxious) dog and put her at ease. Didn’t try to up-sell. Kind and compassionate.

Way to expensive was told one shot would cost up to 45.00$ when in the office the price went up to 170.00 with office visit, and I let them know he didn't need exam left and received the shot for 56.00,literally  down the street at petrol in strip mall.

Everyone here is so kind, friendly and knowledgeable. My dog, Norman, had a Pexi surgery done and I think it was more scary for me than it was for him! The Andersonville team continued to check up on him, and were there for all of my questions. I felt very confident in his care team. The facility itself is very clean and very comfortable. Everyone we delt with just went above and beyond.
Very kind vets, technicians, and staff - they were great with our two very anxious, frightened kitties.

Bad communication. They dont follow up or do progress check ins. They also overcharge. Front desk people can be a bit dismissive and not so friendly. Vets seem nice and knowledgeable. But one of the vets is fresh off of school and it shows.

I have had nothing but the best experience finding Dr McCarthy at Good Vets.  My dog was soooo sick back in nov 2025 and Dr McCarthy was absolutely so caring and kind and provided excellent care for my pup.  Obviously I was so worried and Dr McCarthy made sure she had a plan and communicated it thoroughly to me.  She even did follow up calls to make sure that my pup was getting better.

I was with my previous vet (out of state) for about 25 years so finding a new vet was difficult for me and my attachment issues :)  Dr McCarthy is the midwest version of my previous vet and the best fit.  We saw her for our annual exam yesterday and it just touched my heart that she thought of my dog after only meeting her once under awful circumstances.  This means a lot because the providers you try to find - you want to find someone who loves what they do and the people/pets they work with.  And if it means more in the review - my dog wags her tail the entire exam - so the tail is the better review!!
Thanks for the 5 star review, Jeannette!

I appreciate that GoodVets is very considerate and willing to accommodate our furbabies regardless of time or circumstances. The vets & staff who are taking care of my Voldemort are all very gracious & I am very thankful.
GoodVets Andersonville’ Dr. McCarthy has helped my toy poodle a great deal, she follows-up and makes sure that Voldemort’s condition is indeed improving.. thank you!
Always a great visit!
Thank you so much for your review, Michelle!

They were awesome very attentive to both of us, very sweet and professional staff.
Great service!
technician didn’t charge me for anal gland expression since my dog didn’t need it.

Had to change my review from 5 to 2.
Last tech visit was a little unpleasant. I used to work in the vet industry for several years and can tell some of the workers are new to the field. Anyways, my dog loves people but she is very strong and she doesn't understand that and can overdo it when trying to greet people.

First of all, I do not know why the receptionist left her desk area to weigh my dog when I could have handled it and usually do. I have warned them in the past of her energetic greetings and how she can be too much to handle. Not sure if they put alerts or notes for certain patients. For example, my dog is friendly with people but very dog reactive. There were a few instances now where no one would check to see if the lobby was clear of dogs before bringing her out. I literally had to jump and speak up just as they opened to door to bring my dog out but there was a dog in the lobby.

Anyways, the other receptionist lady who has checked us in the past never leaves her desk area to weigh a dog.. I was giving my dog some time to wind down before walking her over to the scale. I didn't say anything to not be rude and thought, oh she wants to say hi and be helpful. I was not expecting the receptionist to kneel all the way down which was not a good idea. When I was a vet tech and worked with an overly excited pitty who didn't know its own strength, I kept my distance to avoid being hit in the face when they try to lick you.  I would keep my distance until the dog calms down enough for me to proceed to pet or perform a blood draw, etc.

I had asked her if she was OK after it all happened really fast. She didn't say much after and so I backed off. I don't care if you don't want to say anything further to the owner, but why be cold towards my dog after the incident that you sort of provoked? It was uncalled for and just thought it was so unprofessional. Even when I was a vet tech and got bit, scratched, hit in the head, etc from a patient, I would never hold any resentment towards the animal.

Aside from this clinic being super expensive, the workers can sometimes be a little cold and not courteous sometimes. I wish I read the reviews before dropping already over 1k at this place. The exam fees are outrageous and it has always been this way in vetmed especially in the city where everything is expensive. I get vet med can cause major burn out, but never treat clients with such dismissive attitude, ESPECIALLY the patients! It really feels awful especially when an animal doesn't know any better. At the end of the day, they are animals. She is a rescue as well, so we have no history on her past and has been through a lot. We have tried training her in the past. But this is just how she is.

Once my dog is done doing her laser therapy here, will be taking her back to Fox Lake Animal Hospital.

I just had the best experience here at Good Vets! These are the nice people in the world. My cat was so calm with them. They are so patient. Also from my stress. My sugar went too low . They even helped with that!!  They also explained everything to me in detail and answered all my question in detail. They are truly Rockstars!!
Had a wonderful first visit with my dog. The team was very friendly and welcoming (for both me and my pet). I greatly appreciated the detailed explanations of care and pricing transparency.
Thank you for the five star review, Cheyenne!

THEY'RE VET TECH CHOKED MY DOG TILL HIS TONGUE AND LIPS TURNED BLUE.

I went in to have my dog checked out for a cough. They had a tech helping the vet with my small dog. The tech was holding my dogs neck so tight that his eyes glazed, lips and tongue turned blue. I had to physically remove the vet tech from my dog for him to come to consciousness.
For obvious reasons, they said that visit was covered and that apologized profusely. Also, for obvious reasons I switched vets and location.
Come to almost a year later they put a hold on my account not allowing any appointments till I pay that very expensive vet bill. Conveniently- no one from the incident works there and can attest to the situation. So when I spoke to their current new office administrator- She claims none of it happened because they didn't have that in their records. Even though I've already had several appointments after the fact where there was no bill or issues.
This place has the worst communication and lack of accountability I've ever seen. Do not trust them. Or Make sure everything that happens is documented for yourself
Good experience. Very friendly.

Cannot recommend enough! I can’t relate to the 1 star reviews at all— they provided me with affordable options, were so amazing with my cat, and offered recommendations for pet products that my cat absolutely loved! Thank you Dr. Elder and team!!
Brought my dog in for a trim and gland expression. Pricing was good and they presented the cost to me before they started, which I really appreciate. Service was great. Will be back.
Thank you for your review. We look forward to seeing you and your fur babies at their next appointments!

I took my cat in to the vet and they were there for over 2hrs. Then they had me use the app to sign up for some payment plan thing. Next thing I know I'm charged $800 on top of a $300 visit and the only way to request a refund is to reach out through their App and pray they get back to me even though it's been over a week! ABSOLUTELY UNACCEPTABLE.

The people there may be nice, but they have huge flaws. First, the pet visit is expensive, it's about $200 just to see your pet. When they see you they'll want to do a bunch of tests, which is great. However, the prices to do the tests are outrageous. Just to do a few blood tests, the bill would have been over $700. I'm pretty sure this is why people don't take there pets to vets regularly to make sure there health is good, they're over charging you and it's not something everyone can afford. Also don't call past 6pm, it becomes an emergency clinic and the staff are pretty rude.

This is the most predatory vet experience I have had. They tried to sell me a year long protection plan before they even took my cat out of the crate, and now they are auto-scheduling appointments and harassing through text and email. Avoid this place.

Extremely expensive for absolutely nothing. I've been to this place over the years for convenience because you can usually find an appointment at one of their locations quickly. I was at Uptown yesterday to check on my dog's heart murmur, which they have documented, and her possibly associated cough. They wouldn't give her any medication without an almost $400 x-ray, which wouldn't necessarily give us any answers anyway. I said I'd see how a cough suppressant ($40) went in the next 24 hours. That did nothing, so today the appointment is at Andersonville, and because it's a different doctor, they're making me pay the $102 for the SAME EXACT EXAM I had done YESTERDAY with one of THEIR vets. Finally got her medical records and am going somewhere else.
Thank you for your review Delicia! We look forward to seeing you and your fur baby at their next appointment.

Exceptional Customer Service : My daughter brings her pup here and she’s recently been inquiring a lot with the team regarding her dogs care and I’m usually present as well and we just want to write this review to highlight Sam , not sure if they’re a vet tech or receptionist maybe both but either way they exemplify perfect customers service. Sam has been attentive, kind, understanding and so very patient with my daughter and all her questions. This is something sadly we don’t see a lot in customer service so please management highlight Sam who has been amazing with our family ! Thank you . If you’re looking to speak to someone and inquire with someone Sam is so knowledgeable and kind amazing for nervous pet parents too!

Good Vets has been taking care of my Pekingese Dinky & Himalayan Persian Sophie, since they were little.  They always take good care of them!  Soph just got her yearly checkup & rabies.  Thanks again Good Vets & Staff!

I’ve taken my senior cat here for about 2 years. The doctors and staff are super attentive and caring. Always a good experience and I love that I can schedule appointments online, usually within a day or two.
Very attentive to our pup, thank you ✨

I'm not a big review person in fact this is probably the first one I have ever wrote. My dog actually goes to goodvets in uptown which we love, but last night they didn't have any appointments, so I decided to call the andersonville location. A wonder person by the name of Ann answered the phone, she was so compassionate and concerned for my dog Letty. I was blown away with her level of customer service in a high stress situation I was experiencing. She gave me signs to watch for and although they didn't have an appointment for Letty she consulted with the staff and gave me even more instructions and recommendations. I was so blown away with how great Ann was and wanted to leave a review as a thank you to her. As someone who works in customer service I can say this kind human left a lasting impression on me and I am extremely thankful. If she sees this Letty got into the vet this morning and will be ok in a few weeks. Thank you again for your compassion and professional manor. You are a rock star and Good vets is lucky to have you. Keep up the good work.
Thank you for the rating Lilly! We look forward to seeing you and your fur babies at their next appointment!

I have taken my fur baby, Reco, to several veterinary locations, but none have compared to the outstanding care we received at GoodVets in Andersonville. We were fortunate to meet Lewis, an exceptional vet tech who made a remarkable difference.

Reco is extremely anxious, and until we met Lewis, no one was able to calm him down. Lewis has a golden touch when it comes to handling pets. He is patient, understanding, kind, and highly professional. He took the time to explain everything thoroughly, which not only eased my concerns but also helped Reco feel more relaxed.

I truly wish there were more vet techs like Lewis. He has a heart of gold, and it’s evident that he loves what he does. I hope GoodVets recognizes the invaluable asset they have in Lewis. His kindness and expertise in treating my fur baby, Reco, are deeply appreciated.

I would not recommend this place
to anyone.  At my pup’s last or 3rd appointment, the vet could not even review my pups chart accordingly and failed to remember the course of action and what was discussed at my pet’s second appointment.  The vet could not even get the sex of my puppy right.  I also strongly believe a lot of my pet’s issues should’ve also been discussed and assessed at her initial or first appointment. The fees at this establishment are outrageous.  They will charge you
a fee for a simple follow up.  I will discontinue all future services from Goodvets!
Informative and swift. Patient-centered.

Everything was wonderful!!!!  Everyone was so warm....Dr. Martinez explained everything to me and a course of treatment....I'm so happy I found you in the middle of replacing Broadway Animal Hospital as incompetent. My 14 year old cat is now on the mend bc of GoodVet and she's feeling better now.
Thank you for the 5 stars, William! We look forward to serving you and your fur baby again in the future.
The assistants Kelsey and Josh were pleasant, informative, and gentle with Linxi.
All the information and instructions are clear. They always care for my pet with love, respect, and gentleness.

AWFUL. There is no other word I can use to describe my experience at GoodVets Andersonville besides negligent. I brought my sick cat here hoping to get answers and proper medical care. At first, the staff appeared kind and reassuring. That kindness turned out to be meaningless without competence and follow-through.

During our first visit, they attempted to submit a UTI culture and failed to do so successfully. There was no meaningful apology on their part. I was simply given a credit for a future visit. Because they did not seem concerned, I trusted that it was a mistake that would not happen again. It did happen again — and this time, it happened while my cat was critically ill.

A few weeks later, my cat became a true emergency case. She had to be sedated and subjected to invasive blood and urine testing. For the second time, GoodVets failed to ensure that the samples were properly processed. My dying cat was forced to endure another stressful and painful round of testing for absolutely no medical benefit because the results were never obtained.

When I confronted them, they deflected responsibility by saying the samples were “sent,” as if sending alone satisfies the standard of care. After already botching a prior submission, they knew failures were possible and still failed to confirm receipt in a critical case. In my opinion, that is not just a mistake — that is a breach of a duty of care owed to patients. Because of their repeated failures, we never received results that could have guided treatment. My cat passed away days later. I will always live with the knowledge that her final days could have been handled more peacefully or more effectively if this clinic had done its job.

Even after everything, they did not automatically refund my money. Instead, I was forced to schedule a phone call and actively ask for my money back while grieving the loss of my pet. That alone speaks volumes about their ethics and accountability.

I am absolutely disgusted by how this was handled. I trusted this clinic with my cat’s life, and they failed at the most basic level. I would never bring another animal here and strongly warn others to think twice before trusting GoodVets Andersonville in a serious medical situation.

This was my first visit with my dog to the Andersonville Goodvets location.  My prior Animal Hospital of over 20 years closed its location near my house and I had to find a new vet for my dog.  I could not have been more impressed with the level of care and service the we received from the entire staff, from reception to vet tech to doctor, during the course of our visit.  I highly recommend this Goodvets location to anyone with a pet.
Thank you for your positive review Robert. We look forward to seeing you and your fur babies again in future!
First visit.  Took us right in.  Seemed engaged.  Very nice and personable.

A week ago, I had to say goodbye to my little furry friend. The folks at this location gave my sweet buddy a gracious send-off while somehow simultaneously offering comfort to me as I was a bumbling wreck.

It can be hard to recognize when our best friends are winding down, and it is ultimately up to each pet parent to make those determinations themselves. But I am confident that if you are working with the staff here, you will feel in the best hands with your pet's health.

Thanks for being the rare combination of stoic and empathic on my hardest day.
it was great and everyone was super friendly.
Both our dogs are vetted here on their care plan.  We've been pleased with the staff and doctors here for the last couple of years.
Thank you for your review and we look forward to seeing you at your next visit!
Thank you for the review, Erica. We look forward to seeing you and your fur baby again soon!
This is a wonderful clinic. The vets and staff are friendly, professional, and go out of their way to provide support and care. Beyond impressed - highly recommend!
We were there a couple of weeks ago and folks there were very nice and welcoming. They are pricey though hense why I gave them 4 stars

Got talked into the wellness plan for my 12yo cat. Big mistake, as they sent an estimate for dental work that's almost $2K above what the plan covers because "pricing is set by corporate." The last time I took my car in for dental at my old vet, it was $850 for a cleaning and two extractions. I'll let them do exactly what's covered by my plan, which they say is $1700 worth of work (!), but due anything else, I think I'll have to drive the hour back to my old vet.

Really negative experience with front desk staff the last 2 times I’ve been in to get meds for my
Dog. Specially call to ask to how long things would take as I work 90 hr weeks-was told one price on the phone and then come in to find it’s $45 more-Was told I could come get in meds and that they were open and then proceeded to have to wait outside for an hour In the middle of the daywhen again I called specifically to ask certain times so that I’m not wasting anyone’s time and never is it what they say on the phone. Same front desk worker every time extremely rude-Will be moving my car to a different center as it’s very clear that their price gouging compared to everyone around the area-just doesn’t feel good to be lied to by your vet multiple times when you’re giving them the care and money regarding what is ultimately my child

Threatened my cat by offering to feed her to a howling dog patient. Didn't send rabies tags for seven months despite calling for them multiple times. I had to call every day for three weeks to get a renewal of my cat's daily prescription. Every single attempt to get basic treatment has been an uphill battle. They sent me my medical records for my "bad patient" cat (they sent me an email about her using those words) but when I called to have my other cat's records sent, they said they had a policy that prevented them from doing so. Wild incompetence and consistently poor treatment of my cats -- an absolute nightmare to get baseline care.
The vets and staff at GoodVets are amazing. I feel more than comfortable dropping my dog off and knowing she is being taken care of.
Fun and friendly staff. Very little waiting for the two times I’ve been here.
Not a good experience.  Don't go here, they are all about money, not your pet.

We have been going to GoodVet since they opened. I have to say I’ve gotten used to the minimal interaction between vets and my dogs. But! I was recently impressed with Dr. Brian for being so thorough with Mochi. He checked her spine after reading her notes on having IVDD and checked her legs and heart health. He even suggested she lose some weight. I really appreciate the honesty and care. Will go back to see Dr. Brian.
I cannot recommend this vet enough. They took amazing care of our little guy and kept us informed and updated every step of the way. They are truly a God send!
Excellent service. Very pleasant visit.

You are better off piling your money up and setting it on fire than to go to this business. Corporate chain that will nickel and dime you at every turn. $400 for an EAR INFECTION is crazy but then when their treatment doesn’t work and you come back less than 2 months later they find it reasonable to want to charge you full price again for something they couldn’t fix. This is the place you think of when it comes to the gouging vet industry. Don’t waste your or your pets time.
OVERPRICED SERVICES, if you are planning to come keep in mind non charges are known until you first pay their $100 “check” and will try to charge you even $1400 for vaccines package????🤡🤡🤡🤡 …
Excellent care for your pets.   Staff is very attentive and thoughtful.  Calming music and treats in exam rooms

If you really care about your pets and want them to get good care, do them a favor and don’t go to GoodVets. I’ve had way too many issues with this place and each time they’ve shown a disturbing lack of accountability.

First, they asked me to bring in a fecal sample for my dog which I hand-delivered in person. Days went by with no update. When I finally followed up, they took forever to respond, then claimed they couldn’t find it and acted like I’d never dropped it off at all. If they had just checked their cameras, they’d know I did. The way it was handled was careless and dismissive.

The worst part? No one seemed to care until I brought the issue up to corporate. Only then did anyone start responding or attempting to fix the issue.

Then, when we got our dog neutered there, we also asked them to microchip him. We thought that was all set, but months later at a check-up, we found out they never actually did it. They didn’t take responsibility either, just tried to shift the blame. On top of everything, they never call to explain or fix things, they just leave voicemails and avoid talking.

There are plenty of better places out there that actually own their mistakes and care about your pet. I wouldn’t trust GoodVets again.

Dr. McCarthy is my savior. I adopted a very anxious cat who needed so much care and was commonly miserable with ear infections and arthritis. I saw a few other vets in the area and was met with judgement until I met with Dr. McCarthy. Polly was peeing with freight each time I tried to take care of her, and wouldn't take her medication. Dr. McCarthy suggested multiple solutions that lead to a regiment that ended with my senior kitty living her BEST life. After 4 years of owning this cat, Polly has started cuddling with me! It was such a long road, but Dr. McCarthy took the time to listen and come up with solutions that worked for both Polly and myself. I'm so sad that I moved too far away and can no longer come here, but I am so thankful we found a routine that works before I had to leave and hope to move closer in the future to come back. Obviously, I highly recommend. THANK YOU!!!

I have been to this location twice now with my anxious pup. They have been welcoming, calm, and so patient with her. I feel comfortable addressing my concerns and feel confident that Lola is getting the best care. The whole staff is amazing. I would recommend.

GoodVets Andersonville was incredible during one of the most difficult times. My cat, Spats, had suddenly gone blind and was very ill. I initially took him to GoodVets Evanston. While the vet there was kind, he wasn’t very helpful—he prescribed eye drops and said to wait a week. A few days later, my cat was getting worse. When I reviewed the visit summary, I noticed they hadn’t taken his temperature or blood pressure, despite suspecting hypertension as a cause of the blindness. When I asked, the vet said they didn’t yet have the equipment since they’d just opened.

I had already paid for an office visit, and some basic care had been missed, so I asked if he could coordinate with another GoodVets location to get my cat seen quickly. That’s how we ended up at GoodVets Andersonville—and I’m so glad we did.

From the moment we arrived, the vet and staff were caring, compassionate, and thorough. The vet clearly explained our treatment options, followed up with calls to check on my cat, and even offered additional medication suggestions without requiring another visit. Sadly, my cat was too sick to recover, but I truly believe that if we had gone to the Andersonville location first, Spats might still be with us.

Always calm and quiet. From the front desk staff, to the vet tech/ veterinarian. Always a great experience. Speaking with Dr. Katy is like chatting with a friend about your kids. Understanding and professional!

Our vet did comp our visit (!!!) which was very unexpected and kind. I think they might be having some logistical challenges that have caused a few lapses, and I appreciate them working to fix that.

Great service and recommendations.  The staff well knowledgeable and handled my dog with excellent care.  The front desk was prompt in providing me with the necessary paperwork for reimbursement with my pet insurance.

HIGHLY recommend getting the Wellness Care plan. The monthly payments are a fraction of what the yearly need would cost without the plan.

Overall, lovely place that makes me and my cat feel taken care of.

Dr. McCarthy has consistently been incredibly kind, communicative, and helpful during every visit. We faced significant communication issues during our visits. Each time we came in for simple lab work for our cat, unexpected charges appeared on the invoice. While one tech eventually acknowledged my concerns about these added expenses, it was frustrating to navigate lengthy explanations.

Additionally, one front desk employee made interactions more challenging, and during one visit, we waited over an hour for a routine procedure without any acknowledgment of the delay.

The vet techs are clearly trying their best, but the overall experience felt lacking. I recommend seeking a local vet instead, as this corporate environment seems to prioritize financial gain over patient care. I'm giving 2 stars for the techs' efforts, but I was disappointed overall.
